facts.fact: The document states construction of Phase 1 of the National Telecommunications Backbone Project (PBNT), a 307 km fibre link from Ouagadougou to Po under a contract with Huawei, began on 10 December 2017.

The document states PBNT Phase 1, a 307 km fibre backbone linking Ouagadougou and Po (capacity 1,600 Gbit/s, serving ten municipalities), was completed and officially inaugurated on 26 October 2021; it is part of a planned 5,740 km, EUR 175 million programme.
